A man reads a newspaper in a chair as a woman sits at the piano, smiling gently. Degas painted his friend Manet and his wife Suzanne. Manet later cut a piece off the canvas because he didn't like how Suzanne looked, which upset Degas. It's a famous story.

A nervous man in a theater looks out as a lamp holds a ghostly light, while a monster-like figure watches. Goya painted a comic scene to poke fun at superstitions. It's a spooky painting with a silly side. It's one of his best-known works.

A band of musicians plays on a platform in front of a circus, under the glowing yellow gas lights. Seurat painted tiny dots of color to capture the glimmer of the evening. The figures look as stiff as statues. It's a magical, strange picture.

An old woodcutter, bent under a heavy load, is startled by Death, who comes to take him. Millet based it on a fable by La Fontaine, in which the man changes his mind about wanting to die. The painting shows the hard life of a working man. It's a famous story told in paint.

People hurry in all directions across the oldest bridge in Paris, under a cloud-filled sky. Renoir painted a crowd of cabs, walkers and umbrellas in tiny dabs of color. It's a lively snapshot. It's a fresh, early Impressionist city scene.

George Washington, his wife Martha, and her grandchildren sit around a table with a map of the new capital city, with an enslaved servant at the side. Savage painted it in 1796 and it was widely copied as a print. The picture shows the nation's first family in their elegant home. It also reminds us that the Washingtons enslaved people.

A woman in a black jacket and an orange-yellow hat sits at a table, with a thoughtful expression, against a mustard-yellow wall. Van Gogh painted Agostina Segatori in Paris in 1887, using strong complementary colors. The yellow and blue-black seem to hum. It's a vivid early portrait in his new colorful style.

paintings.t: The Hungry Lion Throws Itself on the Antelope
paintings.why: A lion leaps onto an antelope amid giant, lush jungle plants with huge blossoms. Rousseau never saw a jungle but visited Paris zoos and botanical gardens for ideas. The brightly colored leaves and flat shapes give it a dreamy, storybook feel. It's one of his wildest jungle scenes.

Eighteen young women in flowing gowns, each with a musical instrument, glide down a spiral staircase. Burne-Jones painted this with a quiet, dreamy rhythm. The softly colored dresses make it feel like music in a picture. It's one of the most beloved Victorian paintings.

A huge stone cup stands on the shore of a tiny island, with a miniature world inside it, in a mysterious seascape. Cole painted a giant's goblet, which may be a symbol of the rise and fall of civilization. It's one of his most mysterious paintings. People still wonder what it means.

A young woman carries a heavy water jar on her shoulder, with a strong, calm face. Goya painted this around 1808–12 with a loose, quick brush. He admired ordinary people who held up society. It's a fine portrait of dignity.

Jesus sits in shadow, in the dim light of a lamp, after dinner, as Judas leaves the room with a huge shadow. Nikolai Ge painted the emotional moment before the betrayal. The dramatic lighting was new for religious art. It caused a sensation in Russia in 1863.

Sunlight on melting snow around a cottage, with a tree and a horse, in early spring. Levitan painted the first days of spring in Russia with a clear, bright eye. The blue shadows on the snow are lovely. It's a fresh landscape.

paintings.t: Gather Ye Rosebuds While Ye May
paintings.why: Young women in soft, flowing dresses gather pink roses in a sunlit garden. The title is taken from a famous poem that tells us to enjoy life while we're young. Waterhouse painted the faces and the flowers with great skill. It's a gentle and lovely picture.

paintings.t: The Vision to the Youth Bartholomew
paintings.why: A young boy named Bartholomew kneels, as a monk in black appears in the meadow, in a calm, golden evening. Nesterov painted the vision of the future St. Sergius of Radonezh. The landscape is shimmering. It's a quiet and holy picture.

Whitewashed cottages glow with the last red rays of the setting sun, as the dusk covers the fields. Kuindzhi painted the village in warm and cool light. The shining color made visitors gasp. It's a famous glowing landscape.

A young man in a clergyman's coat leans toward a woman, in a woodland, with ivy carved with their initials. Hughes painted a couple who must wait years to marry. The meticulous details of leaves and bark are amazing. It's a touching story.

paintings.t: The Finding of the Saviour in the Temple
paintings.why: The young Jesus is surrounded by teachers in a temple, as his parents arrive to find him. Hunt spent years in the Holy Land to paint authentic costumes and architecture. It sold for an enormous sum at the time. It's a famous Pre-Raphaelite painting.

paintings.t: A Meadow in the Mountains: Le Mas de Saint-Paul
paintings.why: A meadow of wildflowers stretches below craggy mountains, with big pine trees and a fresh blue sky. Van Gogh painted it near the asylum where he stayed. The brushwork is lively. It's a happy, free landscape.

Two girls in white dresses drift in a rowboat on a calm green river. Monet painted them near his home in Giverny, in the glow of the water. The reflections are rippling and beautiful. It's a beautiful scene of summer.

A busy Paris boulevard is seen from above, with crowds and carriages that are painted as tiny dabs. Monet painted this from the studio of the photographer Nadar. A critic mocked it as 'black licks of tongue'. It's an important and vibrant Impressionist picture.
A woman in a dark dress leans on a tomb at a cemetery, looking back at us. Goya's painting hangs on the wall of his house. Leocadia Weiss was his housekeeper. It's a striking portrait.

A Breton woman in a traditional dress sits in front of a colorful, round background with a Japanese-style design. Gauguin painted the portrait of Marie-Angélique Satre. She didn't like it, though, and refused to take it. It's a fascinating mix of old and new.

paintings.t: Bella and Hanna. The Eldest Daughters of M. L. Nathanson
paintings.why: Two teenage sisters in plain dresses sit close together, holding each other. Eckersberg painted them in 1820 for their father, a banker in Copenhagen. The soft light and quiet closeness make it very touching. It's one of the most-loved Danish portraits.

A woman in a saffron robe stands with four arms, holding a book, rice, cloth and a rosary, in an Indian landscape. Abanindranath Tagore, an Indian artist, painted her as 'Mother India' in 1905. It was a symbol for the independence movement. It's a landmark of Indian modern art.

paintings.m: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
paintings.why: A wedding party fills a courtyard in Morocco, with musicians, guests and the bride in a rich costume. Delacroix visited Morocco in 1832 and was struck by the color. He painted this from sketches. It's a window into a different culture.

paintings.t: Portrait of the Artist with the Yellow Christ
paintings.why: Gauguin sits in front of two of his paintings, a yellow Christ and a strange ceramic pot, with a cool gaze. He painted himself among his own work. The bold flat colors and shapes were new. It's a confident self-portrait.

A young woman in a country dress sits by a stone wall, her work in her lap, looking up as if she's been interrupted. Bouguereau painted a calm and pretty scene. The lighting and polished skin are typical of him. It was a favorite of American collectors.

A single stalk of asparagus lies on a table, painted with just a few strokes. Manet made this after a collector paid more than he asked for another painting of a bunch of asparagus. It's a joke, a little 'thank you' note. It's a tiny gem.

paintings.t: Still Life with Profile of Laval
paintings.why: A pot, fruits and flowers on a table, and the profile of a young man's face seems to float in the background. Gauguin painted it as a tribute to his friend Charles Laval. The mix of a portrait and a still life is playful. It's a clever picture.

A woman leans down from heaven over a golden bar, her arms folded, as lovers below on Earth remember each other. Rossetti painted it from his own poem. The picture is full of golden hair, lilies and angels. It's a rich, dreamy Victorian picture.

A woman in a red robe looks into a crystal ball in a dim, magical room full of strange instruments. Waterhouse painted a fortune-teller. The glowing orb is the center of the picture. It's a picture of mystery.

A woman in a white and blue hat sits with a teacup in her hand, in a room with patterned wallpaper. Cassatt painted her mother, Lydia, relaxing at home. The quiet, everyday scene is full of charm. It's a lovely picture.

A little boy, Cupid, whispers to a girl, in a meadow of wildflowers and soft light. Bouguereau painted many scenes like this. The smooth, delicate look was very popular. It's a sweet and charming picture.
A woman and a young girl are in a rowboat on a lake in a park, in soft daylight. Berthe Morisot painted it with light, quick strokes. It's one of her best-known paintings. It's a peaceful moment.

Sunlight falls on a floor and a woman sits by a window in a bright, blue-painted room in Skagen. Anna Ancher painted her own home. She was one of Denmark's best painters, known for her use of light. It's a calm and glowing picture.

paintings.t: Summer Evening at Skagen. The Artist's Wife and Dog by the Shore
paintings.why: The artist's wife walks on the beach with her dog, under a pink and blue twilight. Krøyer painted the tender glow of a northern evening. The sea is a soft, glassy color. It's a peaceful scene.

Fairies dance in a circle on a misty meadow, in the pale light of a summer night, according to Swedish folk tales. Malmström painted the scene in a soft, glowing way. It's a magical picture. It's one of the most beloved Swedish paintings.
A simple black cross shape floats on a white background. Malevich made it as part of his Suprematist series, along with the Black Square. The shapes are like symbols. It's an art of pure shapes.

paintings.m: Musée des Beaux-Arts de la ville de Paris
paintings.why: A philosopher sits with a book, as his two little daughters play beside him. Courbet painted his friend Pierre-Joseph Proudhon, who had recently died, and the children. The scene is quiet and affectionate. It's a deeply human portrait.

A dark city of tall, gabled buildings sits under a stormy blue-black sky. August Strindberg, the famous Swedish playwright, also painted wild, moody landscapes. The thick paint and dramatic mood are unlike anything else of his time. It's a picture from a writer's imagination.
A mother in a flowered hat with her two children, dressed up for a walk, in light and shade. Renoir painted a loving family in a soft, glowing style. It's a charming and tender picture.

The hero Perseus rides his winged horse Pegasus to rescue Andromeda from a sea dragon. Leighton painted a thrilling battle, with a swirl of wings and coils. It's a big and exciting myth. It's an action-packed Victorian painting.

Two ancient Greek poets, Sappho and Alcaeus, perform and listen on a marble terrace beside the blue sea. Alma-Tadema painted a sunny, perfect, imaginary Greece. Each person is shown in elegant detail. It's a lovely vision of a poet's world.

A woman in an elegant Albanian costume with a gold-embroidered jacket looks calmly out, in front of a pale background. Kolë Idromeno, an Albanian painter, painted it in the 1880s. The textiles are beautiful. It's a treasured portrait in the art of Albania.

Three women in colorful costume relax in a room, with an elaborate pattern of cushions. Renoir was inspired by Delacroix's painting of Algiers. It's a fantasy of an exotic setting. It shows how artists dreamed of other places.
A woman in a green gown sits in the branches of a tree, a book in her lap, looking away. Rossetti used his muse, Jane Morris. A honeysuckle flower grows in her hand. It's a dreamy, romantic image.

A young woman stands in a farmhouse, with her broken basket of eggs, as an old woman scolds her. Greuze painted this story in a soft, delicate way. It's a fine example of a 'moral' picture. It was very popular in the 1700s.

Rows of worshippers kneel on carpets in a grand mosque, with lamps hanging and walls covered in patterns. Gérôme visited Cairo and filled the picture with real architecture. The painting is amazingly precise about its details. It's a window into a world that many Europeans had never seen.

A woman in a silky dark gown leans against a wall, her hands in her lap, with a steady and serious look. Courbet painted the portrait of Mathilde Desportes, a friend. The texture of the fabric shines. It's an elegant portrait by a painter who is better known for his rugged scenes.

A man in a black coat and hat stands on a vast, empty beach with the Mediterranean in front of him, waving. Courbet painted himself, greeting the sea. The enormous sky and sea fill the whole picture. It's a bold, sun-filled seascape.

A group of people gather in a rich, dreamlike garden before the great Flood of Noah's time. Etty painted a lush, paradise-like world about to be washed away. The colors are warm and glowing. It's an imaginative Bible scene.

paintings.t: The Wyndham Sisters: Lady Elcho, Mrs. Adeane, and Mrs. Tennant
paintings.why: Three sisters in pale gowns pose in an elegant drawing room, sitting and leaning together as if they were in conversation. Sargent painted them in 1899, and critics said it looked like a spirited dance of satin and silk. The painting showed Sargent at his best. It's one of the most graceful group portraits.

A woman in a long, dark dress with a hooded cloak, with a sad, strong look, in a Roman setting. Rossetti painted Alexa Wilding as a classic widow. The colors and shapes are bold. It's a statuesque portrait.

paintings.m: Museum of Fine Arts of Nancy
paintings.why: Two strong, bare-skinned figures prepare to cast a net, in a natural landscape. Suzanne Valadon was a painter who started out as an artist's model and became a famous painter herself. She painted people with strength and honesty. It's a lively, vigorous picture.
l: Museum of Fine Arts of Nancy

paintings.why: A woman in a long green-and-black striped dress with a fur-trimmed jacket looks over her shoulder. Monet painted his future wife Camille Doncieux in 1866, and it was a hit at the Salon. He finished it in just a few days. It's a famous portrait that launched his career.

A young girl at the theater sits in a box, leaning forward, absorbed by the show, in a pale dress. Renoir painted the girl's first time at the theater, and her eyes are alight with excitement. The soft colors and gentle brushstrokes give it a lovely glow. It's a happy moment.

Farm workers bend over to dig potatoes in the fields in the late afternoon, as a horse waits. Millet painted peasants as they are, with great respect. The light is soft and golden. It's a fine picture of rural work.

paintings.t: The Seine at Port-Marly, Piles of Sand
paintings.why: Workers unload piles of sand from barges on the Seine, under a wide blue sky. Alfred Sisley painted riverside life with a calm eye. The colors of sky and water are lovely and fresh. It's a quiet picture of a working river.

The young leader Napoleon stands in a red coat with gold embroidery, with a hand tucked into his vest. Ingres painted him at 22, early in his career. It's one of the first images to show the famous hand-in-vest pose. It's a stylish portrait.

Gauguin looks out wearing a hat and a blue coat, a cool, serious expression on his face, against a plain background. He painted this after returning from Tahiti. The strong shapes and calm color are typical of his style. It's a confident look.

paintings.t: Studio in the Rue de Furstemberg
paintings.why: A bright studio in Paris has a stove, an easel and a window, with paintings propped on walls. Bazille painted the place where he lived and worked. It's a window into the life of a young painter. It's a cozy picture of a place for making art.

A group of friends listen as a woman plays the piano, with the lamp light on their faces. Fantin-Latour painted musicians who were friends with the composer Chabrier. The calm group makes a scene of music. It's a lovely portrait of friends.

Heroes of the Trojan War mourn their fallen friend, Patroclus, as his body lies on a funeral bed. David painted this in Rome as a student. The poses are like ancient sculpture. It's a classic scene from Homer's Iliad.

Passengers sit in a crowded, plain railway carriage: a grandmother, a mother with a baby, a sleeping boy. Daumier painted them with great kindness, showing how ordinary people traveled. It's a look at working-class life. It's a famous and dignified picture.

A stag with huge antlers stands proudly on a Scottish hillside, with a misty mountain behind. Landseer's painting became an icon of Scotland and appeared in many advertisements. It was meant to hang in the House of Lords. It's one of the most famous animal paintings ever.

paintings.m: Royal Academy of Fine Arts of San Fernando
paintings.why: A famous actress in a gold-trimmed dress looks out, in a calm pose, with her hands folded. Goya painted María del Rosario Fernández, called 'La Tirana'. The portrait is full of character. It's a fine example of his skill.
l: Royal Academy of Fine Arts of San Fernando

paintings.t: Clair de lune sur le port de Boulogne
paintings.why: Fishing boats and people crowd a harbor under a bright full moon, with a dark sky and silver water. Manet painted the French coastal town in a deep blue night. The moonlight is glowing. It's a magical harbor view.

A bearded man in a blue uniform with a cap stands in front of a patterned green background. Joseph Roulin was a postman and a close friend of Van Gogh in Arles. Van Gogh painted him and his entire family several times. It's a warm portrait of a good friend.

Four young women toss a straw puppet, dressed in a man's clothes, high in a blanket in the open air. Goya painted this as a pattern for a tapestry. The bright colors and fun make it joyful. It's an amusing game from old Spain.

Racehorses gallop straight toward the viewer, in a cloud of dust, on a Paris racecourse. Manet painted the view from the front of the pack. It was an exciting and unusual angle. It was the way a photograph would look.

A woman leans over a balcony as the noise and the clamor of the street seem to rush into her home. Boccioni painted this as a Futurist, showing that the sounds and motion of a modern city mix with our inner lives. The shapes are fragmented and energetic. It's a bold modern painting.

A crowd of tiny fairies, elves and sprites gather around, as a woodsman prepares to split a hazelnut with an axe, in a tangled glade. Richard Dadd painted it over nine years, many of them in a hospital, and filled it with tiny details. It was inspired by fairy tales and Shakespeare. It's one of the most amazing fairy paintings ever made.

paintings.m: Musée des Beaux-Arts et d'Archéologie de Besançon
paintings.why: A young girl with a mass of light brown curls and dark eyes looks out, wearing a light pink dress. Renoir painted Adèle Besson in his later years, in a warm, glowing manner. The portrait is soft and sweet. It's a charming late work.
l: Musée des Beaux-Arts et d'Archéologie de Besançon

paintings.why: Van Gogh paints himself as a Japanese monk, with a shaved head and a intense stare, in a green background. He sent it to Gauguin as a gift, as a sign of friendship. The orange and green colors vibrate. It's a famous early self-portrait.

paintings.t: Snow Storm: Hannibal and his Army Crossing the Alps
paintings.why: A huge black storm cloud swirls over a mountain pass, as tiny soldiers and elephants struggle across the snowy Alps. Turner painted the general Hannibal's journey as a battle between nature and humans. The swirling clouds seem to take over the canvas. It's a wild, stormy vision of an ancient journey.

A girl, wearing a white shift and a pink ribbon, tidies her hair as she looks in a mirror, in a blue-green room. Cassatt painted an ordinary moment of daily life. The softness of the colors is delicate. It's a fine example of her style.

Manet's wife, Suzanne, sits at the piano in a white dress, her face in a concentration. She was a professional pianist. Manet painted a gentle picture of her making music. It's a tender portrait of his wife.

The ancient Greek poet Sappho, with a lyre, looks at the ferryman Phaon, as Cupid watches. David painted it near the end of his career. The soft style is a bit sweeter than his earlier art. It's an elegant and romantic scene.

A small boat of fishermen struggles with the waves by the moonlight, with a bright full moon, under heavy clouds, near the rocky Needles off the Isle of Wight. Turner painted this at age 21, and it was his first oil painting shown at the Royal Academy. It brought him early fame. It's an early sign of his genius for atmosphere.

Three people sit on large rocks beside the water, gazing at the glowing disk of the moon as it rises, with ships in the distance. Friedrich painted the quiet, spiritual scene near the Baltic. The light on the water is magical. It's a famous image of peaceful watching.

A crowd walks in a festive parade through the streets of Florence, as the people marvel at a new painting of Mary carried in a procession. In the story, the painter Cimabue's work was so beautiful that the city celebrated. Leighton painted it when he was 24. Queen Victoria bought it, making him famous.

A mermaid with red hair sits on a rock by the sea, combing her hair, as the water laps around her. Waterhouse painted her with a pearly glow. The sparkle on the waves and the tail are delicate. It's a beloved painting of a creature of fairy tales.

A mother pulls her son's body from the river of the underworld, with a rake, and she patiently brings him back to life. Gallen-Kallela, a Finnish painter, illustrated the old epic poem the Kalevala. The painting is dreamy and powerful. It's a symbol of a mother's love.

Roman senators surround Caesar and lift their daggers, in a swirling, tense scene in the Senate. Camuccini painted the famous assassination of 44 BC with a clear, statue-like style. It's a famous episode that is still discussed. It's a classic of Neoclassical history painting.

Onions, a bottle, a plate and a book sit on a white tablecloth, with big folds of fabric. Cézanne painted the objects with careful attention to shape and balance. The cloth looks like a landscape. It's one of his late, great still lifes.

A tall pile of stones stands in a snowy forest, with snow-covered evergreens. Friedrich painted the quiet beauty of the winter landscape. The cairn, a heap of stones, looks like a memorial. It's a mysterious and calm picture.

Two young women sit side by side, holding hands, one dark-haired and one blonde, as symbols of Italy and Germany. Overbeck painted two close friends, representing a friendship between their nations. The soft colors and delicate lines are like those of the Italian Renaissance. It's a picture of friendship.
A young woman in a pale dress holds a fan in front of a bright background. Renoir painted it in a soft, creamy style in the 1880s. The face glows. It's a picture of grace.

A few cows graze on a green pasture, under a wide sky, painted in thick strokes. Van Gogh painted this in the Netherlands early in his career. He was still learning, and he painted what he saw all around him. It's an early, honest look at the countryside.

Fishing boats rest on the pebbly beach under a bright sky, as sailboats glide across the sea. Monet painted the Normandy coast in simple blocks of color. The sea is a bright turquoise. It's one of his early, sunny pictures.

paintings.t: Brig “Mercury” Attacked by Two Turkish Ships
paintings.m: Feodosia National Gallery I. K. Aivazovsky
paintings.why: A small Russian ship fights off two much larger Turkish ships on a rolling sea with sparks of cannon fire. In 1829, the brig Mercury actually won the battle, and became a legend. Aivazovsky painted the waves in dazzling detail. It's a thrilling picture of courage at sea.
l: Feodosia National Gallery I. K. Aivazovsky

paintings.why: A woman in a simple blouse and a bright red skirt sits reading, with the light on her face, in the shade. Corot is known for his silvery landscapes, but also painted quiet figure paintings. The picture is simple and calm. It's a gentle portrait.

Boys with crutches, who have been affected by polio, bathe in the sea under the watch of a monk. Sorolla painted this to show the bravery of the children, who were treated at the seaside, with the bright, sparkling water. It won a major prize in Paris and Madrid. It's a compassionate and famous picture.

paintings.t: The Duke and Duchess of Osuna and their Children
paintings.why: A noble family stands together in a bright room, with the parents in rich clothes and the children in matching blue and red costumes. Goya painted the family with warmth and grace. The kids seem lively and real. It's one of his best family portraits.

Monet sits with a pipe and a hat, painting, looking calmly. His friend Renoir painted this in 1875, in the garden at Argenteuil. The quick, colorful brushwork shows their friendship. It's a portrait of one great artist by another.

paintings.m: Galleria Nazionale d'Arte Moderna e Contemporanea di Roma
paintings.why: A young man in a blue coat with a hat sits against a yellow-green background, his big hands on his knees. Van Gogh painted him while at the asylum in Saint-Rémy. The colors are vibrant. It's a bold portrait of an ordinary person.
l: Galleria Nazionale d'Arte Moderna e Contemporanea di Roma

paintings.why: The scientist Isaac Newton sits on a rock at the bottom of the sea, absorbed in drawing a diagram with a compass. Blake used him as a symbol of cold logic, though he also admired him. The colors are strange and glowing. It's one of the most famous images of a scientist.

paintings.t: A Group of Danish Artists in Rome
paintings.why: A group of young Danish artists sit in a studio, relaxing, with their pals, and each one is lost in his own thoughts. Hansen painted a portrait of his friends. The warm room looks cozy. It's like a family snapshot of a golden age.

A cart full of farm produce rolls down a country road as a couple of travelers pass, under a cloudy sky. Gainsborough painted the glow of evening light on the trees. The landscape is soft and feathery. It's a favorite of English country scenes.

paintings.t: Yvonne and Christine Lerolle at the Piano
paintings.why: Two young sisters in pale dresses are at a piano, with their heads close together, while the walls behind them have paintings by Degas. Renoir painted the daughters of a friend. The pastel colors glow. It's a happy picture of music.

paintings.t: Adoration of the Name of God
paintings.m: Basilica of Our Lady of the Pillar
paintings.why: Angels swirl around a bright triangle with the name of God in a golden burst of clouds. Goya painted it on the ceiling of a church in Zaragoza, when he was 26. It shows his early talent. It's one of the earliest works of the great painter.
l: Basilica of Our Lady of the Pillar

paintings.why: A wooden armchair with a candle and two books stands in a room with a red and green floor. Van Gogh painted this chair as a portrait of Gauguin, who lived with him. The chair is empty, but its details tell us about the person. It's a clever, quiet picture.

paintings.m: Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco
paintings.why: The tall, new iron tower stands against a sky, with tiny dots of pale colors, in a delicate, shimmering landscape. Seurat painted the Eiffel Tower in 1889, the same year it opened. It's one of the earliest paintings of the tower. It's a symbol of the modern world.

paintings.m: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
paintings.why: A French diplomat in a blue uniform, wearing a tricolor sash, with a big hat, looks out, with a keen face. Goya painted the French ambassador to Spain. The bold colors and the mood of a new era are striking. It's a very modern portrait.

A bridge crosses the Seine, with boats and trees, in a pale blue sky and soft light. Sisley painted the peaceful river in the Impressionist style. The colors are fresh and cool. It's among his best-known paintings.

paintings.t: Lady Cockburn and Her Three Eldest Sons
paintings.why: A mother sits in a classical pose, as her three little boys cuddle around her, one of them hugging her neck. Reynolds painted it to resemble a famous Renaissance painting of a holy family. The affection feels real. It's a charming family portrait.

A huge snowy peak rises beyond a mountain lake and a camp of Native Americans in the foreground. Bierstadt traveled west in 1859 to paint the real Rockies. The glorious light and huge scale amazed viewers in the East. It helped make the American West a legend.

A sea siren with long hair sits on a rock, gazing out at a ship, as she sings in the glow of the sunset. Waterhouse painted the dangerous, beautiful singer of Greek myth. The warm and cool colors are charming. It's a captivating painting.

paintings.t: The Subsiding of the Waters of the Deluge
paintings.why: A rainbow arcs over a quiet landscape as the great flood recedes, with a lone figure on a rock. Thomas Cole painted the moment of hope after the Flood. The glowing sky and the bare rocks show the world renewed. It's a majestic painting.

A young woman stands in a London shop doorway, with a bundle in her arms, as shoppers pass outside. Tissot painted the busy life of the city's department stores. It's a picture of working women of the day. It shows what the city was like.

A girl sits on a rock in the countryside, knitting, with her gaze on a distant place. Bouguereau painted the soft and sweet picture. It was extremely popular. It shows the idea of a simple, pretty country life.

Diagonal streaks of rain fall across a field of green wheat, with a farmhouse and trees behind it. Van Gogh was inspired by Japanese woodblock prints. The pattern of the rain is a drawing in itself. It's one of his most original landscapes.

Two men hold up the arms of the elderly Moses as the Israelites win a battle below. In the Bible story, as long as Moses' arms were raised, they'd win. Millais painted the quiet strength of friendship. It's a story about helping each other.

A knight on horseback stops at a stone sign in a wide open steppe, with bones scattered around. The sign tells him there are three paths, and each has a danger. Vasnetsov painted this Russian tale of a hero making a choice. It's a beloved fairy-tale picture.

A calm river winds through a landscape of birch trees with golden leaves, in a fresh blue sky. Levitan painted the light of an autumn day in Russia. The colors make the whole canvas glow. It's among the most beloved Russian landscapes.

A woman in a rich gown hands a drink to a knight, as a red-haired woman, seen from behind, watches. Evelyn De Morgan painted the legend of Tristan and Isolde. The jewel-like colors are glorious. It's a beautiful story told in paint.

A boy rides a huge red horse into the water, as the red and blue and yellow colors gleam. Petrov-Vodkin painted a bold, simple shape that seems to float. He was inspired by old Russian icons. In its day, it became a symbol of Russia's future.

paintings.t: Zenobia found by Shepherds on the banks of the Araxes
paintings.why: Shepherds in a lush, green landscape find the exhausted queen Zenobia of Armenia by the river. Bouguereau painted it when he was young, and won an award. The clear light and smooth figures are typical. It's an early success.

paintings.t: The Princess from the Land of Porcelain
paintings.why: A woman in a Japanese kimono stands before a painted screen on a rug with a fan in her hand. Whistler was crazy about Asian art and filled the room with objects. The result is more about harmony of color than a portrait. It's a favorite of his Aesthetic style.

A wide, still lake lies beneath a heavy, cloudy sky, with a faraway shoreline. Levitan painted the huge, empty beauty of Russia. The calm and silence are almost musical. It's one of his last great landscapes.

A sunny corner of old Moscow, with a church, houses with a green garden, and a woman with a child. Polenov painted a bright summer day. The warm tones and the clear light were new in Russian art. It's one of the most loved Russian paintings.

paintings.m: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
paintings.why: A young girl holds a broken pitcher and a bunch of flowers, her face half sad, half shy. Greuze painted the girl in a soft light. The broken jug is a symbol. It was a famous image in 18th-century France.

A young woman in a blue-and-white dress, who represents Finland, is attacked by a huge black eagle that stands for the Russian Empire. She clutches a book of laws. Edvard Isto painted this in 1899 as a protest. It became a strong symbol of Finnish pride and independence.

paintings.t: Arles: View from the Wheat Fields
paintings.why: A wheat field in the foreground, and the roofs of the town of Arles beyond, lit by the sun. Van Gogh painted it on a bright June day in 1888. The sky is clear and the colors are cheerful. It's a happy painting.

A young officer stands at ease, leaning against a tree with his legs crossed, in a red coat. Reynolds painted the graceful pose, with a loose, dreamy background. It's one of the most elegant male portraits of its time. It's a very stylish image.

A huge, golden valley fills with mist, between granite cliffs, as a tiny river flows, in a sunlit glow. Bierstadt's painting, in 1865, helped convince people that Yosemite should be protected. It became a national park later. It's a majestic view of nature.

A little girl in a white dress and a pink sash sits on the ground in a garden, with her hands clasped, looking up. Reynolds painted the nine-year-old. The soft light and her sweet expression are charming. It's a favorite among his child portraits.

paintings.t: I Saw the Figure 5 in Gold
paintings.why: A big golden number 5 repeats on a dark background, with fire engine lights and sounds. Charles Demuth based it on a poem by his friend William Carlos Williams, about a fire truck racing through the city at night. The painting seems to speed past. It's one of the icons of American modern art.

paintings.t: A Road at Saint-Remy with Female Figure
paintings.why: A woman walks along a road lined with orange trees and bushes, in a bright mid-day light. Van Gogh painted it when he stayed in Saint-Rémy. The colors are strong. It's a peaceful stroll.

A woman in a white dress stands in a golden, flowery garden, with a pair of birds fluttering around her. Rossetti painted this vision from the Italian poet Boccaccio. The bright colors are lovely. It's a poetic picture.

Workers dig a trench in the road in a bustling London street, as people of all classes go past. Ford Madox Brown spent years on this painting, as a picture of the dignity of labor. It's full of detail, with a story to tell in every corner. It's a famous picture of the Victorian world.

Branches of white chestnut flowers stand out against a clear blue sky. Van Gogh painted it in May 1890, just months before his death. The tall flowers are painted with lively strokes. It's one of his last paintings of spring.

paintings.t: Cart with Red and White Ox
paintings.why: A farmer drives a red-and-white ox along a track pulling a cart in a field. Van Gogh painted the peasant life of the Netherlands in earthy colors. The ox is sturdy and patient. It's an early painting from his Dutch period.

paintings.t: Portrait of Frédéric Chopin and George Sand
paintings.why: The composer Frédéric Chopin and the writer George Sand were friends, and Delacroix painted them together, Chopin at the piano. After Delacroix's death, the canvas was cut in two. The halves hang in different museums today. It's a famous example of a double portrait that was split apart.

A woman in a long red robe with a golden cap stands in a garden of roses, holding Cupid's letter. Marie Spartali Stillman was one of the best women painters in the Pre-Raphaelite circle. The colors are rich and glowing. It's a lovely story.

A boy stands on a rocky hill by a pond, looking out at us from a flat, stiff pose. Rousseau, who had no art teacher, painted in a naive, flat way that has a magic of its own. The leaves and rocks are carefully outlined. It's a charming and odd picture.

A crowd in rich costumes gathers in a church for a wedding in 18th-century Spain, with silk, lace and lots of tiny details. Fortuny painted it in glittering color. It sold for a huge price when it was shown. It's a dazzling showpiece.

A tall pine tree frames a view of the distant mountain, with fields and a viaduct below, in bands of green and blue. Cézanne painted Mont Sainte-Victoire again and again, near his home in Provence. The branches make a pattern. It's one of his best-known landscapes.

paintings.m: National Museum of Art, Architecture and Design
paintings.why: A deep valley opens below a steep mountain farm, with a waterfall and a village, under a sky of golden clouds. Johan Christian Dahl was a Norwegian painter who loved the grandeur of his country's landscape. The view is real and still looks the same today. It's a national treasure.
l: National Museum of Art, Architecture and Design

paintings.why: A woman in a blue-green dress holds a lamp, standing in front of a cluster of sunflowers, a tall figure with sad eyes. In Greek myth, Mnemosyne was the goddess of memory and the mother of the Muses. Rossetti painted the figure of Jane Morris. It's a mysterious picture of remembering.

The scientist Louis Pasteur sits in his laboratory, with a flask in his hand, looking thoughtfully. Albert Edelfelt, a Finnish painter, painted him at the moment of his triumph, after the rabies vaccine. It's a famous portrait of a great scientist. It reminds us how much we owe to science.

A woman with long red hair holds a jar of ointment and looks out, in a richly colored background, with a Renaissance feel. Frederick Sandys painted her as a famous character in the Bible. The details of the jewelry and fabrics are dazzling. It's a celebrated Pre-Raphaelite portrait.

A sorceress in a gorgeous robe prepares a magic potion, as she stirs a cauldron, surrounded by the tools of magic. Frederick Sandys painted every detail of the setting with care. She is a character from Greek myth who used magic to help Jason. It's a vivid and richly colored picture.

A man in a top hat, with his two daughters, walks across a big, empty square in Paris. Degas painted the family of Viscount Lepic from an unusual angle, with the people cut off by the edges. It looks like a photograph. It's a very modern composition.

Young ballet students in white tutus wait while a teacher leans on a cane, in a studio with a big window. Degas painted the dancers at work, rather than on the stage. Each one stretches, fiddles or waits. It's a famous look behind the scenes.

A group of bathers by a river, in the shade of trees, in the strong sun of a summer day. Bazille painted young men as they relaxed, in a bold, bright style. The colors and light were new. It's one of the first paintings of modern leisure.

paintings.t: Polish Hamlet. Portrait of Aleksander Wielopolski
paintings.why: A pale young man in a dark coat stares out as a group of ghostly figures looms behind him, in a dreamlike scene. Malczewski, a Polish Symbolist, painted a young man in a Hamlet-like pose. The picture is about the burden of history. It's a famous image from Polish art.

A giant tree with swirling golden branches curls across the canvas, with birds. Klimt designed this as a mural for a mansion in Brussels. The spirals are a symbol of life and growth. It's one of the most famous patterns in art.

A woman and a baby sit in the stern of a boat with a boatman rowing, over bright blue water, with a big yellow sail. Cassatt was inspired by Japanese woodblock prints. The flat shapes and bold colors make it a favorite. It's a joyful family scene.

A desperate woman holds her sons in a cave, with fear in her eyes, as they cling to her. Delacroix painted this tragic story of Medea. The drama is powerful. It's a painting about the tragic end of an old Greek tale.

paintings.m: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
paintings.why: A young woman is laid in a grave in a natural setting by a priest and a Native American man who loves her. Girodet painted a scene from a novel by Chateaubriand. The silvery light is dreamlike. It was a sensation in Paris in 1808.

A snowy street runs through a village, with figures in dark clothes and houses with orange roofs. Monet painted the winter in Argenteuil in soft grays, with blue shadows. The quiet is palpable. It's a wonderful snow picture.

paintings.t: Still Life: Vase with Pink Roses
paintings.why: A vase of roses on a table, in front of a pale green background, with a splash of pink and white. Van Gogh painted it in the last months of his life, at Auvers. The green and pink are lively together. It's a cheerful painting.

People sit in a noisy beer hall as a singer performs in the background, with a waitress looking at us from a table. Manet painted real life in a Paris café. The figures are painted with quick, loose strokes. It's a lively scene.

A huge oak tree spreads its branches over a field, with a cow beneath it. Courbet painted the tree near his hometown, and it became known as 'Courbet's Oak.' The thick, rich painting is rugged. It's a monument to a tree.

paintings.t: Snow Storm: Steam-Boat off a Harbour's Mouth
paintings.why: A steamship pitches in a whirlwind of snow, wind and waves, with only a few lines to show the ship. Turner said he had himself lashed to the mast of a ship for four hours in a storm to see it for real. Critics called it 'soapsuds and whitewash.' It's among his most dramatic seascapes.

The king's favorite sits at her embroidery frame in a gorgeous dress, in a luxurious room. Boucher painted her as a beautiful and cultured woman. The dress and flowers are full of lovely details. It's a pretty example of French Rococo style.

paintings.t: Mr and Mrs William Hallett ('The Morning Walk')
paintings.why: A young couple strolls through a feathery woodland, in elegant clothes, with a little dog. Gainsborough painted a glorious sense of movement and light. The fabric seems to flutter in the breeze. It's one of the most graceful portraits.

A distant mountain valley darkens in the evening, with small figures, a church spire and a fence. Friedrich painted a quiet end to the day. The calm colors of the sky are lovely. It's a peaceful landscape.
The river Seine reflects the sky, with boats, trees and buildings on the far bank. Monet painted it in 1873 near Paris. The colors are fresh and clear. It's an early Impressionist landscape.

A group of hunters in red coats pauses for a meal in a forest clearing, with hounds and horses. Courbet painted the life of hunters in a bold, dark style. The painting shows the strong colors of the countryside. It's a lively picture.

A huge field of wheat rolls under a heavy, dark blue sky. Van Gogh painted it in July 1890, shortly before his death. The sky is stormy and the field is a warm yellow. It's a powerful picture of nature.

Swirling colors and lines crash together across a big canvas, in a wild abstract design that seems to explode. Kandinsky based it on the Great Flood, but hid the story in shapes. It took him months to figure out, until he repeated the word 'overflow' to himself. It's one of the great abstract works.

A cyclist speeds through a swirl of colors and broken shapes, as if time is stretched. Boccioni painted this in the Futurist style, which celebrated speed. The picture seems to vibrate. It's an exciting picture of motion.
A woman in a white dress sits on a red sofa, with the dappled light of a sunny room. Joaquín Sorolla painted his wife Clotilde. The light on the dress glows. It's a loving and sunny portrait.

A church by a lake stands on a cliff beneath a huge, stormy sky, with a tiny figure. Levitan said this was his most important painting, a 'portrait of Russia.' The clouds are huge and the water dark. It's a very impressive landscape.

A woman wrapped in a patterned cashmere shawl sits in a swirl of fabric, with her eyes lowered. Sargent painted his niece, in a dazzling mix of colors. The shawl's patterns blend with the pose. It's a bold, flashy portrait.

A woman in striped trousers sits on a bed with a pipe and some books, in a blue room, as a pattern on the cover. Suzanne Valadon painted a modern, independent woman. The bold colors and shapes are cheerful. It's a famous painting by a pioneering woman artist.

paintings.t: The Arrest of Diepo Negoro by Lieutenant-General Baron De Kock
paintings.why: In 1830 the Javanese prince Diponegoro was arrested by the Dutch after a long war, as his people looked on. The Dutch painter Pieneman showed the prince calm and proud, but the picture is told from the Dutch side. Years later, the Indonesian artist Raden Saleh painted his own version of the arrest, so the two paintings show how one event can look very different depending on who tells the story.

A woman at an ironing board looks out with a tired expression, among baskets of laundry. Toulouse-Lautrec painted a working woman with respect. The simple colors are mournful. It's a picture of ordinary, hard work.

paintings.t: The Signing of Peace in the Hall of Mirrors, Versailles, 28 June 1919
paintings.why: Dignitaries from many countries sit and stand in the Hall of Mirrors at Versailles, signing the treaty that ended World War I. Orpen painted the moment in 1919. The room, with chandeliers and mirrors, is shown in a calm, grand, formal way. It's an important record of history.

paintings.t: A Cart on the Snowy Road at Honfleur
paintings.why: A horse and cart stand on a snowy road, with farm buildings and bare trees, under a hazy winter sky. Monet painted the quiet snow in subtle tones of gray, blue and brown. The picture shows his early talent. It's a peaceful winter day.

Farmers work in a hayfield, pitching hay and loading wagons, with white oxen and a distant mountain. Bonheur painted the farm work with energy and love of animals. The glowing hay is lovely. It's a bright harvest.

Diplomats in black coats sit around a big table at the signing of the treaty that ended the Crimean War, in a grand room. Dubufe painted the 1856 meeting with a formal arrangement. It's an official record of an important moment. It's a window into European history.

paintings.t: Virgil reading The Aeneid before Augustus, Livia and Octavia
paintings.why: The Roman poet Virgil reads his epic poem aloud before the emperor Augustus and his family, and the sister, Octavia, faints with grief at the mention of her dead son. Ingres painted the emotional scene with clear, classical lines. It's a tribute to the power of poetry. It's a famous and moving painting.

A man in a black top hat sits at a café table, with a glass, looking out in a quiet way. Manet painted his friend at the famous Café Tortoni. The black suit and the white tablecloth are painted with great skill. It's a lively sketch.

A young woman in a dark cloak stands in a field in the evening light, with her flock of sheep, knitting. Millet painted her in a quiet, golden twilight. The picture feels peaceful and timeless. It was widely loved in its time.

A woman in a white dress and a pink hat sits in a garden full of roses, with the sun on her face. Krøyer painted his wife in the garden in Skagen. The light is warm and the colors are soft. It's a beautiful summer scene.

Artist friends sit around a table in a village inn, talking and relaxing, as a waitress clears the table. Renoir painted his friends, including the painter Alfred Sisley. A dog sleeps on the floor. It's a warm group portrait of friendship.

A grand country estate in England sits across a green lawn, with cattle and a lake, and the sky full of clouds. Constable painted it for the owner. The light and clouds are carefully observed. It's a lovely view of the English countryside.

The queen of Egypt, in a gown of silver and white, lifts a pearl and prepares to dissolve it in a cup of vinegar, to prove she can spend more at a feast than Mark Antony. Tiepolo painted a joyful, glittering banquet. The sparkling colors are brilliant. It's a fun story from history.

paintings.t: Portrait of Georgiana, Duchess of Devonshire
paintings.why: A fashionable woman in a huge feathered hat, with a graceful, relaxed look, turns toward us in a soft light. Georgiana was one of the most famous figures in English society. Gainsborough painted her with loose strokes.

Crowds of people and carriages move through a busy Paris boulevard in a flickering blur of light and color. Renoir painted the city bustle with quick, soft strokes. You can almost hear the crowds. It's a lively city scene from the early days of Impressionism.

Circles, lines and angles float on a white field like notes in a piece of music. Kandinsky taught at the Bauhaus art school in Germany, where he mixed geometry with colorful, lively shapes. He believed that shapes and colors have feelings. It's a famous abstract painting.

A big yellow rectangle, a red cross and a blue circle collide on one canvas, with lines and arcs. Kandinsky wanted to show how color and shape affect our feelings, a bit like music. He called each element by its own feeling. It's a bold and playful abstract picture.

paintings.t: Self Portrait in a Straw Hat
paintings.why: A woman with a straw hat decorated with a feather and flowers, holding a palette and brushes, looks out with a bright smile. Vigée Le Brun painted herself after seeing a famous painting by Rubens in Antwerp. She became one of the most successful portrait painters in Europe. It's a lively self-portrait.

paintings.m: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
paintings.why: A mother hugs her little daughter in a loose white dress, with a close and loving look. Vigée Le Brun painted herself and her child Julie, in a simple, natural style. It was a modern, tender way to paint motherhood. It's one of the loveliest mother-and-child pictures.

paintings.t: The Entrance to the Grand Canal, Venice
paintings.why: Gondolas and boats glide in front of the white church of Santa Maria della Salute under a bright blue sky. Canaletto painted views of Venice that travelers bought as souvenirs. The sparkling water and clear light are amazing. It's one of the most famous city views.

A table in a sunny garden room is set, with fruit and a half-finished meal, and a woman and child in the doorway. Monet painted his own family's lunch, with an ordinary scene made beautiful by the light. The empty table suggests a story. It's a peaceful look at home life.

A watery view of Venice, with palaces and boats shimmering in the pastel light of the water. Monet visited Venice in 1908 and made dozens of paintings. The buildings seem to melt into the water. It's a dreamy view.

A row of cottages with mossy roofs lines a street in Auvers, with green gardens and a pink path. Van Gogh painted the village where he spent his last weeks. The colors are fresh and bright. It's a happy village view.

A young couple sits on a swing, in a green forest, dressed in white. Pierre Auguste Cot painted this romantic scene, and it became hugely popular. It was shown at the Paris Salon of 1873. It's a sweet and sunny picture of young love.

Bare, dead trees rise from a calm lake, in the Catskill Mountains of New York, under a stormy sky. Thomas Cole painted the wild America, with a touch of sadness. It's one of the first paintings by the founder of the Hudson River School. It's a famous early American landscape.

A flat, gray-green sea stretches under a pale sky, with a faint sail on the horizon. Courbet painted the quiet sea with a few bold strokes. It's a very simple and modern scene. It's one of his most peaceful seascapes.

Colorful houses line a canal in Zaandam in Holland, with their reflections in the water. Monet painted many scenes in the Netherlands in 1871. The reflections shimmer. It's a bright and cheerful picture.

A girl in a white dress sits curled up with a tabby cat on her lap, both looking sleepy. Renoir painted the cat and the girl in soft, warm colors. It's a charming picture of a girl and her pet. It's a favorite of cat lovers.

paintings.t: The Artist's Mother Ane Hedvig Brøndum in the Red Room
paintings.why: An elderly woman in black sits upright in a red-walled room. Anna Ancher, a Danish painter, painted her mother with great love and respect. The strong red contrasts with her black dress. It's a moving portrait.

paintings.t: A Young Artist (Ditlev Blunck) Examining a Sketch in a Mirror
paintings.why: A young man in a dressing gown sits in a studio, holding his drawing up to a mirror to see it with fresh eyes, a trick that artists use. Wilhelm Bendz, a Danish painter, painted his friend. The mirror shows what he's missed. It's a clever and thoughtful picture.

A young woman sits by a lake in a field of flowers, with a faraway look, in a pale, flowing dress. Waterhouse painted Shakespeare's Ophelia, in the sad moment before the end. The flowers are meticulously painted. It's one of several Waterhouse paintings of this character.

paintings.t: Peter the Great Interrogating the Tsarevich Alexei Petrovich at Peterhof
paintings.why: The tsar Peter the Great sits in a room with his son, as the young man looks away, in a tense face-off. Ge painted the story of a ruler who had to decide between a father's feelings and the good of the state. It was a huge sensation in Russia. It's a great psychological drama.

paintings.t: Portrait of the Actress Antonia Zarate
paintings.why: A woman in a black dress and a simple veil sits with her arms crossed, a calm and thoughtful look. Goya painted the actress Antonia Zárate in the last years of his life. The quiet figure is sculptural. It's an elegant portrait.

paintings.m: National Museum of Art, Architecture and Design
paintings.why: A huge mountain emerges from a thick fog above a calm, dark fjord, in an eerie light. Peder Balke, a Norwegian painter, used just a few strokes. The shape of the Stetind rises like a monument. It's a spare and powerful image.
l: National Museum of Art, Architecture and Design

paintings.why: A ruined Welsh castle tower stands on a rock above a lake, with mountains and a stormy sky. Turner painted it when he was 25, and it earned him membership in the Royal Academy. The moody light is dramatic. It's an early landscape masterpiece.

paintings.t: The Large Plane Trees (Road Menders at Saint-Rémy)
paintings.why: Workers dig up the road under huge plane trees with yellow leaves, as a couple strolls along. Van Gogh painted the thick tree trunks in dark, bold outlines. The bright color and strong shapes are lively. It's an autumn scene.

Three sisters in white sit around a table, sewing and working on lace, in a quiet sunlit room. Reynolds painted them in 1780 with elegant ease. The soft light and calm are charming. It's a very popular English portrait.
A woman in a bright red scarf and a yellow-brown dress stands in a window, painted in a muted setting. Monet painted his wife Camille. The pose is thoughtful and calm. It's a gentle portrait.

paintings.t: Joaquín Sorolla García dressed in white
paintings.why: A little boy in a white sailor suit stands in a sunny room, looking out with a calm and shy smile. Sorolla painted his son Joaquín. The white clothes are a treat for the eyes. It's an affectionate portrait.

A shady forest path in the sun, with the light speckling the trees and the ground. Sorolla painted the garden of a palace near Madrid. The bright and dark spots of light are lively. It's a refreshing view.

A tall woman in a pink gown points toward a poet, as they stand in a jungle clearing with blooming flowers. Rousseau painted his friend, the poet Guillaume Apollinaire, with a muse. The flat, magical garden is a work of fantasy. It's one of his last paintings.

A dark funnel cloud twists toward a farm, as a family rushes to a storm cellar, with wheat blowing and animals in panic. John Steuart Curry painted the drama of a Midwestern twister. He was a leader of the Regionalist movement. It's among the most famous pictures of American weather.

Two young women in fancy dress lean on a balcony as two men in dark cloaks lurk behind, in the shadows. Goya painted the scene of old Madrid, full of mystery. The bright dresses glow in the shade. It's a well-known painting.

paintings.t: A Young Tiger Playing with its Mother
paintings.m: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
paintings.why: A tigress lies on the ground, with her cub playfully batting at her. Delacroix studied animals at the zoo and painted them with great energy. The warm colors of fur are beautiful. It's a sweet picture of wild animals.

A young man in a Spanish-style costume stands, with his hand on his hip, against a plain background. Manet's brother Gustave posed. The bright costume stands out. It's an example of Manet's love for Spanish style.
A bullfighter raises his hat to the crowd, in a gold-embroidered suit, with a spectator behind. Manet admired Spanish art and painted a bullfight in Paris. The pose is dramatic. It's a bold painting.

Boys and girls in ancient Sparta challenge each other in wrestling and races, as the old women watch. Degas painted this early in his career. The poses are lively and the faces are real. It's an imaginative picture of ancient life.

A group of poets and writers, including the famous Paul Verlaine and Arthur Rimbaud, sit at a table in a dark café. Fantin-Latour painted this portrait of a literary club. The faces look serious. It's a record of a gathering of important writers.

A large eagle owl lies still, with its soft brown feathers, on a plain surface. Manet painted this still life near the end of his life. The quiet, dignified bird is a tribute to nature. It's a rare, thoughtful painting.

A young woman in a black dress and a bright hat leans on her hand, with a soft, relaxed look. Renoir painted her in a glowing light. The black is painted with different colors of blue and brown. It's a lovely portrait.

A young woman helps a hidden soldier, a royalist during the English Civil War, who is hiding in a hollow oak tree, hugging him in secret. Millais painted the story with great romance. The details of the leaves and moss are beautifully done. It's a tale of loyalty and love.

A Paris street is jammed with waving flags and a sea of tiny dabs of color, on the day of a national holiday in 1878. Monet painted the celebration from a balcony, with fast strokes that capture the excitement. The flags seem to flutter. It's one of the most joyful pictures of a city.

Two Tahitian women sit and lie on a veranda in the heat of the afternoon, resting. Gauguin used flat, rich colors, to show the warmth of the tropics. The mood is quiet and drowsy. It's a view of an island afternoon.

Passengers wait on a quay in the sun, as a big ship from England is docked in the port, and a young woman looks out with an umbrella. Manet painted the busy scene in 1869. The people in the foreground are shown from behind. It's a lively modern snapshot.

paintings.m: Museum of Fine Arts of Lyon
paintings.why: A singer in a bright dress performs on stage in an outdoor concert garden at night, lit by gas lamps. Degas used the strong colors and shadows of stage lights. The painting was inspired by the Paris nightlife. It's a lively picture of entertainment.
l: Museum of Fine Arts of Lyon

paintings.why: A group of people play music and relax in a woodland, in a dreamy, misty landscape. Corot painted a poetic and gentle scene, in a soft silvery light. It's a tribute to the joy of music in nature. It's a calm and beautiful picture.

A calm bend of the river, with soft blue reflections and a tree-lined bank, and a few houses, under a blue sky with clouds. Alfred Sisley painted the peaceful French countryside in the Impressionist style. The sky is as important as the land. It's a lovely river view.

paintings.t: The Red Roofs, Côte Saint-Denis at Pontoise, Winter Effect
paintings.why: A village with red roofs sits on a hill, behind bare trees, in the winter. Camille Pissarro painted the peaceful French village with a careful eye. The warm roofs stand out against the cold. It's a beautiful winter scene.

A queen in a dazzling gown, with her hair loose and a jeweled crown, prepares to go before the king, in the Bible story of Esther. Millais painted her with a mix of fear and courage. In the story, she risks her life to save her people. It's a portrait of bravery.

Anglers sit in a boat on the river, with a village behind them, in the sun. Monet painted the quiet, simple pleasures of the countryside. The light on the water is shimmering. It's a relaxing picture.

A group of men sit close together around a table, as one of them reads aloud from a newspaper. Goya painted the figures in a dark and moody way, as one of his Black Paintings. It's a strange and mysterious picture. People still discuss what they might be reading.

paintings.t: The Farewell of Telemachus and Eucharis
paintings.why: The young Telemachus, son of the hero Ulysses, says goodbye to the nymph Eucharis, who is sad, as they stand on a shore with Cupid. David painted this when he was in exile in Brussels. The pose is clear and graceful. It's a classical love story.

A quiet river curves between trees under a pale blue sky, with soft reflections. Sisley painted the countryside near Paris, in the light of a spring day. The picture is gentle and peaceful. It's a soothing landscape.

Sailboats and rowboats race on the Thames in a breezy day, as spectators watch from the bank under a sky of white clouds. Sisley painted this during a visit to England in 1874. The light is crisp. It's a happy scene of boating.

The town hall is decorated with flags for the national holiday, as people stroll, in an evening glow. Van Gogh painted it on July 14, 1890, Bastille Day, in the final weeks of his life. The flags and the festive mood are bright. It's a cheerful picture of a French village.

paintings.t: La Femme à la cafetière (Woman with a Coffeepot)
paintings.why: A woman in a long blue dress sits very straight, near a table with a coffeepot and a cup, in a calm room. Cézanne painted her in a solid way, with a focus on shapes. The picture is monumental and still. It's one of his great late portraits.

A woman in a pink morning dress holds a parrot on a perch and a bunch of violets, with a distant look. Manet's model was Victorine Meurent, who appeared in several famous paintings. The soft pink is lovely. It's a charming portrait.

A group of people play croquet in a garden of dappled shade, with a woman in white in the foreground. Manet painted the Paris suburbs on a sunny day. The light and shade are carefully observed. It's a leisurely and happy picture.

paintings.t: In the Salon at the Rue des Moulins
paintings.why: Women in colorful gowns sit on sofas in a lavish, red-lit parlor, waiting, looking bored. Toulouse-Lautrec lived in a Paris boarding house and painted the everyday lives of women there with compassion. He didn't judge them. It's a painting of ordinary life.

A woman rides a horse around the ring, in a red frock, as a ringmaster cracks his whip, and a clown watches. Toulouse-Lautrec loved the circus and painted it with flat, bold colors. The lines are lively. It's an exciting scene.

A thin, young poet with a sharp look, in a dark jacket, sits against a night-blue background full of stars. Van Gogh painted his friend, the Belgian painter Eugène Boch, with a sky of stars as a halo. He said he wanted to paint a poet with an infinite background. It's a lovely portrait.

paintings.m: Musée des Beaux-Arts de la ville de Paris
paintings.why: An art dealer in a dark suit sits stiffly with his hand on his chin, in a studio. Cézanne made Vollard sit for 115 sessions, and said he wasn't satisfied. Vollard was the dealer who gave Cézanne his first big exhibit. It's an unfinished masterpiece.

paintings.m: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
paintings.why: A young woman in a white dress sits in a simple chair, her hands in her lap, with a sad and gentle look. David painted her with simplicity in 1794. She was executed soon after, which makes the portrait even more moving. It's a hauntingly beautiful picture.

paintings.m: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
paintings.why: A man in a dark green coat and tall boots stands beside his horse, looking out calmly. David painted his brother-in-law in a relaxed pose. The warm colors are rich. It's a beautiful and elegant portrait.

A young mother in a long white dress holds her baby on her lap, with a sweet smile, in front of a plain wall. David painted the simple portrait of the mother and son. The white dress glows. It's a modern, charming picture.

paintings.m: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
paintings.why: A cavalry officer on a rearing horse turns in his saddle, sword in hand, as smoke and flames swirl behind. Géricault painted this when he was 21, and it was a sensation at the Salon. The dynamic composition looks like a movie still. It's a landmark of Romantic art.

paintings.t: Self-portrait in front of a mirror
paintings.why: A young man with glasses looks at himself in a mirror, painted in quick, rough strokes. Toulouse-Lautrec painted his own face as a student. The style is loose and sketchy. It's an early self-portrait.
A doctor in a red robe and a white wig looks forward with calm authority. David painted Alphonse Leroy, a famous doctor, at work. The red is rich. It's a strong portrait.

Two women in feathery hats and black dresses stand on a city street, with sharp angular shapes and men crowding around. Kirchner painted Berlin in 1913 in the Expressionist style, with jagged lines and acid colors. It shows the energy and tension of a big city. It's a landmark of German art.

A train puffs smoke on a railway bridge over the Seine, with sailboats on the water, in a bright blue sky. Monet loved painting the modern age. The steam and sails mix in the light. It's a lively view.

A woman in an elaborate, shimmering robe of gold and green stands under an arch, in a tall, narrow design. Mucha made this poster for the famous actress Sarah Bernhardt in 1894, and it made him instantly famous. Posters of this style became known as Art Nouveau. It's one of the most famous posters in history.

The river has overflowed and covers the road in front of a wine merchant's shop, as a boat floats in the street. Sisley painted the flood in the cool gray light. The reflections are lovely. It's a beautiful look at a natural disaster.

A bright yellow cow leaps through a landscape of blue and red hills, with its head thrown back. Franz Marc used yellow for happiness and joy. The cow seems to dance in the sun. It's one of his most cheerful animal paintings.

paintings.t: Portrait of Adam Mickiewicz on the Ayu-Dag Cliff
paintings.why: A poet in a black cloak stands on a cliff above the Black Sea, with his arms crossed, gazing out at the horizon. Wańkowicz painted Adam Mickiewicz, who is Poland's national poet. The pose is romantic and bold. It's one of the most famous Polish portraits.

Apples on a table with a white cloth, in a rhythm of rounded shapes, in a few brushstrokes. Cézanne said he would astonish Paris with an apple. The fruit is more about shape than anything else. It's one of the great still lifes.

A pile of apples and oranges on a table is arranged against a patterned curtain, in a rich, warm color. Cézanne painted this fruit bowl with a tilted viewpoint. The colors glow like jewels. It's a bold, serene still life.

paintings.t: Woman with a Parasol, facing left
paintings.why: A woman stands on a grassy hill with her parasol and a flowing dress, in a breeze, with a bright blue sky. Monet painted his stepdaughter Suzanne in 1886. It's a lively and light-hearted picture, like a companion to the earlier version. It's one of the best-loved Impressionist images.

A poet in a dark jacket and a bow tie sits with a cigar, with a soft, thoughtful expression. Manet painted his close friend Stéphane Mallarmé. The loose, soft brushwork gives it a warm feel. It's a portrait of friendship.

Strange creatures and a hazy sun seem to rise from the mist, in swirling gold and blue. Turner painted this late in his life as a very experimental picture. It's so abstract that we can't be sure what he meant. It's one of his most mysterious works.

A hospital garden with trees and a pale yellow building, in the golden Provence sunshine. Van Gogh stayed here for a year, painting the world outside his window. The colors are bright. It's a hopeful picture of a hard time.

paintings.t: Restaurant de la Sirène à Asnières
paintings.why: A riverside restaurant, with its colorful tables and trees, is quiet in the sunshine. Van Gogh painted it in dots and dashes, with the influence of Seurat. The colors are bright and joyful. It's an example of his Paris period.

Dancers practice on a stage, with a ballet master and a dancer in the foreground, in a flood of light from the side. Degas painted a rehearsal instead of a performance. The view from above is unusual. It's a look behind the scenes.

A group of cheerful people in fancy clothes pick grapes in a vineyard, in the autumn, with a young boy and a girl. Goya painted this as a tapestry design for a Spanish palace. The colors are rich. It's a happy picture of the harvest.

A farmer works in a wheat field, as the sun rises over the hills, in the swirling morning. Van Gogh painted this view from his window at the Saint-Rémy asylum. The wheat is golden and the hills are violet. It's a gentle and peaceful view.

A dancer in a white dress, with her head thrown back and arms out, dances in a flamenco show, as a group of guitarists and singers clap in the shadows. Sargent painted this in 1882 after visiting Spain. The big canvas has strong light and dark. It's one of the most famous pictures of flamenco.

paintings.t: Day of the God (Mahana no Atua)
paintings.why: Tahitian figures dance, sit and bathe, by a colorful, wavy shoreline, with a god statue at the top. Gauguin painted the lively dreamlike scene with flat, bright colors. The curved lines of water look like abstract shapes. It's a lively and mysterious picture.

A woman and a young boy sit side by side, in a pink and green background, in a gentle mood. Renoir painted Gabrielle, who was his family's nurse, and his son Jean, who became a famous film director. The warm colors glow. It's a tender picture.

George Washington stands in a black suit with an outstretched arm, in a grand room with a table, a chair and books. Gilbert Stuart painted it for a British aristocrat in 1796, and many copies were made. The pose is like a Roman orator. It's one of the most famous portraits of an American president.

paintings.m: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
paintings.why: A woman wearing a white dress and a white headwrap sits, looking over her shoulder, with her bare shoulder, in a calm and dignified pose. Marie-Guillemine Benoist painted her in 1800, soon after slavery was ended in the French colonies. It's one of the first great portraits of a Black woman by a European painter. It was painted by a woman artist at a time when it was hard for women to be artists.

A vase of purple irises, against a bright yellow background, with sprigs of green. Van Gogh painted it just before he left the asylum in Saint-Rémy in May 1890. The bright yellow and purple are strong. It's a vibrant flower painting.

A ship with its blazing sails, in a sunrise full of colors, sails away as the hero Ulysses shouts at the giant Cyclops, a huge shape in the clouds. Turner painted a scene from the Odyssey, in a rich, magic light. The colors are amazing. It's one of his greatest masterpieces.

A tangle of tree trunks and green leaves, painted in blocks of color, with the sunlight coming through. Cézanne painted the forest near Aix-en-Provence. The pattern of the trunks makes a rhythm. It's a rich and quiet scene.

A princess sits on a rocky shore, in despair, as the ship of Theseus sails away, and a little Cupid cries. Angelica Kauffmann painted the story of Ariadne with great feeling. She was one of the most famous women painters of the 1700s. It's an elegant and emotional painting.

A farmer on a cart in a city street at dawn finds a young woman who has fallen on hard times, who turns away in shame. Rossetti painted this story of a person's compassion. It's a picture of kindness. He never finished it, but worked on it for years.

paintings.m: Department of Paintings of the Louvre
paintings.why: A boy in a blue coat and a tricorn hat watches the top he's just set spinning, leaning over a table. Chardin painted the quiet moment with great sympathy. The soft colors are lovely. It's a quiet masterpiece.

paintings.t: Portrait of the Duchess of Alba
paintings.why: A woman in a white dress with a red sash stands with a pointing hand, and in the sand are the words 'Solo Goya.' Goya painted the Duchess of Alba and left a secret message in the ring and the writing. The red and white are striking. It's a mysterious portrait.

A bowl of orange goldfish sits on a table in a bright room, with plants and a blue-and-pink background. Matisse painted the fish many times, since they gave him a sense of calm. The orange shapes pop against the blue. It's a joyful and peaceful picture.

paintings.t: The Channel of Gravelines, Petit Fort Philippe
paintings.why: A calm channel with boats and a lighthouse, made of tiny dots of color, under a soft, hazy sky. Seurat painted this seaside place in northern France. The tiny dots blend in the eye. It's a quiet and luminous scene.

A boy in a blue jacket and a hat sits with a quiet, wide-eyed face. Modigliani painted the portrait of a young peasant in a simple style. The long face and soft colors are typical. It's an affecting portrait.

A huge, one-eyed giant peeks over a hill at a sleeping sea nymph, in a landscape of dream-like colors. Odilon Redon painted a gentle, shy Cyclops. The colors are glowing and the mood is mysterious. It's an unforgettable fairy-tale vision.

A stone bridge with arches crosses a stream near a country house, in an area full of green trees. Cézanne painted the arches and the reflections in blocks of color. It's a clear, solid view of the countryside. It's one of his best-known landscapes.
Peaches and pears are on a table, with a white cloth, in a brightly colored arrangement. Cézanne painted fruit as if it was architecture. The colors glow. It's a delicious picture.

A kneeling knight is about to be dubbed by a lady with a sword as the court watches in a medieval hall. Edmund Blair Leighton painted a scene full of honor and romance. The colors of the gowns are rich and bright. It's one of the best-known images of chivalry.

A spring flood covers a field, with its trees standing in the water, as the ice melts and the sky is a delicate blue. Levitan painted the first sign of spring in Russia. The colors are soft and silvery. It's a delicate landscape.

paintings.t: The Mother of God with the child (Vrubel)
paintings.why: Mary holds the baby Jesus, in a golden, glittering, mosaic-like style. Vrubel painted this icon in Kyiv, Ukraine, for a church. The colors are rich and jewel-like. It's an early work that shows his love of old Byzantine art.

paintings.t: The Victorious Hannibal Seeing Italy from the Alps for the First Time
paintings.why: The general Hannibal stands in the clouds, looking down at Italy, with a golden light and swirling skies. Goya painted this ceiling-like image in 1770 for a contest. He was only 24. The light is a bold choice. It's an early work of the future master.

A bassoon player sits in the orchestra pit, as the dancers in white tutus are cut off at the top of the picture. Degas focused on the musicians, and not the stage. The tutus glow. It's a clever and unusual composition.

A colorful crowd of people in folk costume, with a castle, a river and a pair of lovers, is in a Russian fairy-tale world, painted with dots of pure color. Kandinsky painted a happy dream of old Russia. The dotted colors are lively. It's a colorful and joyful picture.

paintings.t: Lorenzo Pagans and Auguste de Gas
paintings.why: A tenor sings and plays the guitar, as the artist's father listens beside him, in a shadow. Degas painted a famous singer and his father. The mood is that of a family gathering. It's an affectionate portrait of music.

Skulls are piled in a neat pyramid on a table, over a gray cloth, on a green carpet. Cézanne painted skulls to remind himself of how short life is, like many artists before him. He studied the shapes as carefully as he did apples. It's a quiet and serious still life.

paintings.t: Pilgrimage to the Fountain of San Isidro
paintings.why: A group of people gather in a crowd on a hillside with their picnic baskets and flowers, at a festival near Madrid. Goya painted a bright, cheerful festival, as a design for a tapestry. The colors are fresh. It's a happy scene from 1700s Spain.

A warship rests at sea under a gloomy sky, with small boats around it. Manet painted the Kearsarge after her victory in the 1864 naval battle. The sea is a sheet of green. It's a simple and powerful seascape.

A dead rabbit hangs on a hook, painted in soft brown and white, with a few loose strokes. Manet painted this still life near the end of his life. The fur is delicate and soft. It's a quiet and thoughtful picture.
Three sisters in pretty dresses sit, play chess and pose, in a bright room. Sargent painted them in 1884. The quick brushwork is bold. It's a lively group portrait.

A knight on a snowy road, in armor, kneels before a miracle: Jesus bows to him from the cross, as he forgives an enemy. Burne-Jones painted a legend of forgiveness. The colors are deep and glowing. It's a gentle story of kindness.

A young couple in the woods, a barefoot girl in white and a boy, rush through the wind as a storm gathers. Pierre Auguste Cot painted it in 1880, and it was among the most popular paintings of the day. The girl holds a sheer scarf above her head. It's a romantic and dramatic picture.

The sky turns blood-red as mountains crumble and the world tumbles into darkness. John Martin painted huge, apocalyptic scenes. The painting is part of a set on the Last Judgment. It's an awe-inspiring and frightening picture.

A farmer sows seeds across a vivid field, with a bright red sky, as he strides forward. Ivan Grohar, a Slovenian painter, painted the scene in bold colors. The picture shows the dignity of farm work. It's a classic of Slovenian art.

A young woman in a dark riding dress and hat sits on her rearing horse in a flurry of motion, as a little girl looks on from the veranda. Karl Bryullov painted his friend's ward. The horse and rider are painted with great drama. It's one of his most famous portraits.

A wall of a painter's studio, with tools, casts and a drape in a soft light. Menzel painted the corner of his own studio and made it a still life. The messy but lovely details make a charming scene. It's a picture of the tools of art.

A smiling young street seller, with a basket of shrimp on her head, looks out, painted in quick, lively strokes. Hogarth was a master of capturing real life. The portrait is so spontaneous that it looks almost modern. It's one of the most charming portraits of the 1700s.

paintings.t: Gather Ye Rosebuds While Ye May
paintings.why: A girl in a white dress, with a basket of pink roses, in a bright garden. Waterhouse painted this scene based on a poem that urges us to enjoy the day. The dress glows. It's a lovely and fresh picture.

A man bends over a grindstone, sharpening a knife, with a spray of sparks, in a dark background. Goya painted workers like this with a dignified grace. The sparks and shadows are lively. It's an expressive portrait of work.

The ruins of a monastery stand on a rock, among trees, under a stormy sky, as tiny figures walk below. Friedrich painted the haunting remains of a mountain monastery. The ruined arches are poetic. It's a favorite Romantic landscape.

A woman in a white and blue dress, with a feathery hair style, stands in a landscape, as the wind sweeps her skirts, with a column behind her. Gainsborough painted a glamorous portrait of Mary Graham. It's one of the most elegant portraits in British art.

A group of young mermaids sit in a moonlit river and dance, in the night, in a chilly blue light. Kramskoi painted the folk tale in a magical, shimmering, spooky style. The pale figures glow. It's a very atmospheric painting.

A sunny path in a yellow autumn park, with a lone woman in a black dress, leads into a forest of golden birches. Levitan painted this in Moscow when he was a young man. The glowing colors and the mood of the season are lovely. It's a favorite Russian landscape.

paintings.t: Allegory of the City of Madrid
paintings.why: A woman in a flowing robe sits above a shield with a portrait. Goya painted this to honor the city of Madrid. The central portrait was changed several times, as the rulers changed. It's a famous painting with a lot of history.

Two small rats sit on a ledge, in a dim, close-up view in a dark brown background. Van Gogh was fascinated by animals and often sketched them. This early painting is warm and funny. It's a quirky little picture.
